description_en: Queries detailed information about an endpoint that is associated with a basic Global Accelerator (GA) instance
description_zh: 调用GetBasicEndpoint接口查询基础型全球加速实例下指定终端节点的信息
kebab_example: aliyun ga get-basic-endpoint --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --endpoint-id ep-bp14sz7ftcwwjgrdm0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetBasicEndpoint

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the GA instance is deployed. Set the value to **cn-hangzhou**
parameters.help_zh: 全球加速所在的地域ID，仅取值**cn-hangzhou**
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

>  If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the **request ID** as the **client token**. The **request ID** may be different for each request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

> 若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的**RequestId**作为**ClientToken**标识。每次API请求的**RequestId**不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the endpoint that you want to query
parameters.help_zh: 待查询的基础型全球加速实例终端节点ID
parameters.name: endpoint_id
